blocks.text: Private cloud aisa cloud mahol hai jo sirf ek idara (organization) istemal karta hai. Yeh idare ki apni jagah (on-premises) par bhi ho sakti hai ya kisi third-party provider ke paas, lekin doosre idaron ke saath share nahi hoti.

Misal (Example): ek bara bank customers ka hassas (sensitive) data mehfooz tareeqe se sambhalne ke liye private cloud istemal kar sakta hai. Yeh private cloud bank ke apne data centers mein ho sakti hai ya third-party provider sambhal sakta hai, lekin is tak rasai sirf bank ki hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Private cloud public cloud se kis tarah mukhtalif hai (exercise MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: (c) Private cloud sirf ek idare ke liye hoti hai aur data aur security par zyada control deti hai. (Kitab ki answer key yahan (b) deti hai, jo ghalat hai: private cloud kam nahi balke zyada control deti hai.)

items: Private cloud: sirf ek idara; share nahi hoti.
Apni jagah ya provider ke paas; zyada control aur security (bank ki misal).
